comparison.objective: Recover ceramic media through a screen, versus levering a paint-tin lid off with a screwdriver.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring and agitation versus tool insertion into a rim groove and progressive prying.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovered with washers retained and no spill versus lid removed, paint side up, with tin stable.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated lid prying is not the same tested ability as granular classification.
